name: Bitter Snail 5
author: seyed-mohsen-mousavi
description: Glass rounded gray button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes rotate3d(1, 1, 1, 360deg), starts the shadow animation (animating).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bitter Snail 5</title>
<style>
/* Bitter Snail 5 by seyed-mohsen-mousavi — https://uiverse.io/seyed-mohsen-mousavi/bitter-snail-5 */
.button {
  background: rgba(55, 51, 51, 0.49);
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(3.7px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3.7px);
  outline: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 20px;
  transform: rotate3d(1, 1, 1, 320deg);
  filter: drop-shadow(1px 1px 8px black);
  color: white;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: ease-in-out 0.5s;
}
.button:hover {
  transform: rotate3d(1, 1, 1, 360deg);
  animation: shadow 1s both;
}
@keyframes shadow {
  0% {
    filter: drop-shadow(1px 1px 8px black);
  }
  25% {
    filter: drop-shadow(1px 1px 5px black);
  }
  50% {
    filter: drop-shadow(1px 1px 2px black);
  }
  100% {
    filter: drop-shadow(1px 1px 2px black);
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">3D Button</button>

</body>
</html>
